title: Mc Flow
subtitle: Logotype design
description:
"McDonald’s, if it were a crypto company"

The Golden Arches are distilled into a single continuous form, transforming a rigid icon into a fluid system, built around real-time value flow.
This work is part of an ongoing exploration of brand transposition, where I am taking established identities and placing them into unfamiliar industries.
By removing them from their original context, I’m interested in what remains essential/what adapts.
McDonald’s as a crypto company becomes a way to study how a mass-market symbol behaves inside a digital system.
